All names and other identifiers have been removed to secure and respect the privacy of the patient and the family.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EConsent: An informed consent has been taken from the patient in the presence of the family attenders and other witnesses as well and the document has been conserved securely for future references.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu style=\"background-color: #ead1dc;\"\u003ECASE\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 43 year old male presented to the casualty with complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003Eweakness of both upper and lower limbs since 2 days.\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003EHOPI\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E---The patient was apparently asymptomatic 15 days ago, when he developed swelling in both lower limbs and face for which he went to Osmania hospital.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E---After investigations, he was diagnosed to have End stage kidney disease.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- 6 Sessions of dialysis was done in Osmania hospital (Done alternate days). The patient was fine after these sessions.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- On 22-07-23, after the 7th dialysis session, the patient couldn't stand or walk but the doctor told the attenders that it was because of the long dialysis session and discharged the patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- On 23-07-23, the patient still couldn't stand or walk and also had sluggish speech so the patient was taken back to Osmania hospital. The patient wasn't taken care of properly so the attenders shifted him to a private hospital in Alwal.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- On 23-07-23, (S. creat - 7mg\/dl) one session of dialysis was done in the private hospital. The patient was coherent but still couldn't move his lower limbs.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- On 24-07-23, central line of the patient was removed as it was infected. Due to financial issues, patient was discharged from the hospital.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E--- On 24-07-23, patient was brought to our casuality with weakness of both upper and lower limbs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003EPast history\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003EPatient is a k\/c\/o DM - 2 since 10 years. He was using Tab. Metformin 500mg PO\/BD. Since last 15 days, patient is using Inj. Mixtard 8U ---- 6U\u003C\/li\u003E\u003Cli\u003EPatient also has HTN (denovo) since 15 days, using Tab.
